delivery.outcome: Adopt the published immutable Wellmanifest 0.20.46 standard, including canonical worktree admission and multi-agent WIP capacity, then deliver it through the protected ticket branch.
nonGoals: Modify another repository without its own ticket and lease
Edit managed manifest hashes or lease state by hand
Delete or normalize unknown, dirty or legacy worktrees

dataChanges.description: Refresh the repository-local immutable governance projection.
